targets.rawSql: WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(controls.apps1_v) AS "vcu/apps1_v [V]", AVG(controls.apps2_v) AS "vcu/apps2_v [V]", AVG(controls.bpps1_v) AS "vcu/bpps1_v [V]", AVG(controls.bpps2_v) AS "vcu/bpps2_v [V]", AVG(controls.bse1_v) AS "vcu/bse1_v [V]", AVG(controls.bse2_v) AS "vcu/bse2_v [V]", AVG(controls.bse3_v) AS "vcu/bse3_v [V]" FROM controls JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = controls.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(controls.apps1_travel) AS "vcu/apps1_travel [%]", AVG(controls.apps2_travel) AS "vcu/apps2_travel [%]", AVG(controls.bpps1_travel) AS "vcu/bpps1_travel [%]", AVG(controls.bpps2_travel) AS "vcu/bpps2_travel [%]", AVG(controls.brake_light_pct) AS "vcu/brake_light_pct [%]", AVG(controls.brake_bias) AS "vcu/brake_bias [%]" FROM controls JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = controls.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(controls.brake_pressure_f) AS "vcu/brake_pressure_f [psi]", AVG(controls.brake_pressure_rbll) AS "vcu/brake_pressure_rbll [psi]", AVG(controls.brake_pressure_rall) AS "vcu/brake_pressure_rall [psi]" FROM controls JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = controls.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(dynamics.steer_col_angle) AS "vcu/steer_col_angle [deg]" FROM dynamics JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = dynamics.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;
